items_flat.title_en: Musk says he still prefers the Grok app to Grok Bot on hard tasks
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：難題上他仍較常用 Grok App，而非 Grok Bot
items_flat.summary_en: On 30 Aug UTC, Elon Musk posted that he personally still finds the Grok app more useful than Grok Bot for some tasks and urged users to retry it on difficult work, linking the iOS Grok app. Early on 31 Aug UTC he separately quote-posted a user clip of Grok adding video subtitles in seconds, answering only “Grok.”
items_flat.summary_zh: 8月30日（UTC）馬斯克發文稱，部分任務上他個人仍覺得 Grok App 比 Grok Bot 好用，並附上 iOS Grok App 連結，建議大家用難題再試一次。8月31日稍早他又轉發使用者示範：用 Grok 數秒為影片加字幕，僅回「Grok」。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is executive product positioning, not a named model or API ship. It signals that xAI is still treating the consumer Grok app and the Bot/teammate surface as distinct, with the chatbot/app remaining the default for hard interactive work. What remains unstated is any benchmark or roadmap for closing that gap.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長層級的產品定位，不是新模型或 API 上線。它顯示 xAI 仍把消費端 Grok App 與 Bot／隊友介面分開經營，難題互動仍偏 App。尚未說明兩者差距何時、如何縮小。
items_flat.quote: Should say that I personally still find the @Grok app more useful for some tasks than @Bot. Worth trying it out on super tough tasks if you haven’t in a while.
items_flat.quote_zh: 應該說，有些任務上我個人仍覺得 @Grok App 比 @Bot 好用。若一陣子沒試，值得拿超難的任務再試一次。

items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights shareable Grok Bot templates as a way to pass on workflows
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克轉發：Grok Bot 模板可把工作流做成可分享連結
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quote-posted SpaceXAI engineer Matt Palmer’s note that Grok Bot templates package skills, memories, and plugins into a shareable link—described as a blueprint or workflow—and captioned it “How to share your Grok @Bot design with others.” This sits on top of xAI’s existing Grok Bot product (early beta from 11 Aug), not a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克轉發 SpaceXAI 工程師 Matt Palmer 說明：Grok Bot 模板可把技能、記憶與外掛打包成可分享連結，相當於藍圖或工作流；馬斯克配文為「如何把你的 Grok @Bot 設計分享給別人」。這是既有 Grok Bot（8月11日早期測試）的使用方式，不是新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: If templates work as described, Bot value shifts from one-off agents toward portable playbooks. The post does not say whether templates are generally available, how permissions or secrets are handled, or how they differ from Grok Skills.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若模板如所述可用，Bot 的價值會從一次性代理人轉向可攜工作手冊。貼文未說明是否全面開放、權限與密鑰如何處理，以及與 Grok Skills 有何差異。
items_flat.quote: How to share your Grok @Bot design with others
items_flat.quote_zh: 如何把你的 Grok @Bot 設計分享給別人

brief_en: Quiet Monday for lab blogs. No new named model ships. Elon Musk said he still prefers the Grok app to Grok Bot on hard tasks and later amplified a Grok video-edit demo; earlier he highlighted shareable Grok Bot templates. Other frontier labs had no fresh official announcements in the window.
brief_zh: 今日各大廠官方部落格偏靜，無新具名模型上市。馬斯克表示難題上仍較常用 Grok App 而非 Grok Bot，稍後轉發 Grok 影片字幕示範；稍早則強調可分享的 Grok Bot 模板。其餘前線實驗室窗口內無新官方宣布。
